connector.name: Demipass
connector.registryDescription: Credential custody for agents: use secrets blind (ssh/http/smtp/git/db), never in context.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package demipass. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.dustforge, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEMIPASS_TOKEN
env.description: Dustforge JWT bearer token. Self-onboard at https://dustforge.com/.well-known/silicon or mint via the 2FA email flow.
